$comment: Schema and example for docs/DESIGN/domain.json. Captures the vocabulary of the system: entities, relationships, and glossary. Read by sprint plan, sprint roadmap, and design refresh.

entities.name: Entity name in the user's domain vocabulary
entities.definition: One-sentence definition a domain expert would agree with
entities.identity: Field or concept that identifies one instance (e.g., 'order_id')
owns: Other entity names this aggregate owns (optional)

value_objects.name: Value object name
value_objects.definition: What it represents and why it's a value (not an entity)

glossary.definition: What it means in this domain, especially if non-obvious
